samples.summary: Cross-cutting storage invariant is documented inside the font-controls doc rather than the canonical Docs data-model doc
samples.evidence: The new section "Storage invariant: a boolean turned off is *cleared*, not stored as `false`" (docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:232-292) states an invariant that explicitly "holds across the docs engine, the slides text-box editor ... and the Yorkie store" and describes `Doc.applyInlineStyle` / `store/block-helpers.applyInlineStyle` semantics. The canonical place for that is docs/design/docs/docs.md, which is where `InlineStyle` and the "Adjacent Inlines with identical styles are merged" rule live (docs/design/docs/docs.md:96-112) and which is unchanged by this PR. Filing a model-wide invariant under a toolbar feature doc means a reader of the data-model doc never learns why `false` must not be stored, and the README entry for docs-font-controls.md (docs/design/README.md:53) still advertises the file as "curated family picker ... clear formatting", so the invariant is effectively unindexed. Placement preference, not a missing doc — the change does update an existing linked doc rather than adding a parallel one.

finding.summary: New cross-cutting storage invariant is recorded only in docs/tasks/*, not in any design doc

CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 and :58-60 require writing/updating a design doc under `docs/design/<area>/` for a non-trivial change, folding into the canonical doc. The natural homes are `docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md` §"Clear formatting" (which documents the `undefined`-means-remove convention at :229-242 but says nothing about the boolean toggles) and `docs/design/docs/docs-named-styles.md` §"Cascade resolution model" (:117-131, where the false-pins-against-redefinition hazard lives).
